title: Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
abstract: arXiv:2610.32940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the fundamental problem of PAC learning positive linear combinations of $k$ arbitrary ReLU activations on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with respect to the Gaussian distribution, in $L_2$ loss. We give the first fully-polynomial time algorithm for this learning task. Specifically, our algorithm draws $\mathrm{poly}(d, k, 1/\epsilon)$ samples, runs in $\mathrm{poly}(d, k, 1/\epsilon)$ time, and outputs a hypothesis that is $\epsilon$-close to the target concept with high probability. All prior algorithms for this problem require super-polynomial time in $k$ or $1/\epsilon$, or leverage strong well-conditioned assumptions on the weight matrix.   On a technical level, our approach develops a novel boosting procedure of a ``weak'' learner that recovers the hidden weight vectors to constant error, in a list-decodable manner. translated_title: 在全多项式时间内学习ReLU的正线性组合
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上、关于高斯分布、以 $L_2$ 损失进行 PAC 学习的这样一个基础问题：学习 $k$ 个任意 ReLU 激活函数的正线性组合。我们给出了针对该学习任务的第一个全多项式时间算法。具体而言，我们的算法抽取 $\mathrm{poly}(d, k, 1/\epsilon)$ 个样本，以 $\mathrm{poly}(d, k, 1/\epsilon)$ 的时间运行，并以高概率输出一个与目标概念 $\epsilon$-接近的假设。此前所有针对该问题的算法要么需要关于 $k$ 或 $1/\epsilon$ 的超多项式时间，要么需要对权重矩阵施加较强的良态假设。在技术层面，我们的方法开发了一种新颖的“弱”学习器提升过程，该过程能够以列表可解码的方式将隐藏的权重向量恢复到常数误差。为了开发这种“弱”学习过程，我们利用隐式张量计算技术来构建低度……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个在全多项式时间和样本复杂度内、于高斯分布下以L2损失PAC学习k个任意ReLU激活正线性组合的算法，其核心创新是一种以列表可解码方式将隐藏权重向量恢复到常数误差的新型弱学习器提升过程。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first fully-polynomial time algorithm for PAC learning positive linear combinations of k arbitrary ReLUs under the Gaussian distribution in L2 loss, whose key innovation is a novel boosting procedure of a weak learner that recovers hidden weight vectors to constant error in a list-decodable manner.
